# DR. DY Patil College of Pharmacy Akurdi, Pune

> NAAC and NBA accredited pharmacy college in Pune offering B.Pharm, M.Pharm and doctoral programs with emphasis on pharmaceutical education excellence and industry exposure.

Established in 1999, DYP Pharma Akurdi is a premier pharmaceutical education institution affiliated with Savitribai Phule Pune University. The college maintains strong accreditations including NAAC and NBA recognition, and provides comprehensive undergraduate and postgraduate pharmacy education with state-of-the-art facilities.

## Key Topics

- B.Pharm (Bachelor of Pharmacy)
- M.Pharm (Master of Pharmacy)
- NBA Accreditation
- NAAC Accreditation
- Pharmaceutics
- Pharmaceutical Chemistry
- Pharmacology
- Pharmacognosy
- Pharmaceutical Quality Assurance
- Savitribai Phule Pune University
- NIRF Ranking
- Pharmaceutical Education
- Academic Excellence
- Industry Exposure
- Campus Facilities
